summary: Frontend-only UI verification of Cash on Service (COS) feature on web_panel. All 4 scenarios PASS: admin toggle visible+persists; COS-enabled customer checkout shows pay-online + pay-wallet + pay-cos with cos-note (Token/Cash/non-refundable); COS-disabled hides pay-cos while online+wallet remain. Token+Cash math matches total (318.6 + 390 = 708.6).

issues: 'Business Settings' is not reachable via the sidebar navigation (sidebar search returns 'No menu matches Business'). It is only reachable via URL ?tab=business. The NAV array in AdminDashboard.jsx should include a sidebar entry (e.g. under Website/CMS or System) for 'Business Settings' so admins can discover the COS toggle.

test_scenarios.admin_cos_toggle_visible_and_persists: PASS - biz-cos-enabled toggled OFF then ON, each state persisted across page reload
test_scenarios.customer_cos_enabled_shows_pay_cos_and_n: PASS - pay-online, pay-wallet, pay-cos all render; selecting pay-cos reveals cos-note with 'Token to pay now ₹318.6', 'Cash to pay on service ₹390', and non-refundable text
test_scenarios.customer_cos_disabled_hides_pay_cos: PASS - pay-cos absent; pay-online + pay-wallet still render
test_scenarios.regression_online_and_wallet_render: PASS - pay-online selectable, pay-wallet rendered (disabled only because wallet balance=0, which is expected UX)

action_items: (Low priority) Add a sidebar nav entry for 'Business Settings' in web_panel AdminDashboard.jsx NAV so the COS admin toggle is discoverable without manually appending ?tab=business.
critical_code_review_comments: Business Settings page is reachable only via URL ?tab=business - no sidebar link makes the admin feature undiscoverable.
COS feature end-to-end wiring (admin -> site/config -> cart_quote cos/cos_enabled -> Checkout StepReview) works correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used Priya Verma's existing saved Patna address (12 MG Road, 800001)
context_for_next_testing_agent: COS admin toggle lives at /admin?tab=business (data-testid=biz-cos-enabled). After toggling, click biz-save; reload to confirm persistence. Customer flow: /services -> add any non-sub service -> view-booking-bar -> step through checkout (Services, Details, Schedule=emergency, Your Info OTP login, Summary) to reach Review step. Payment selectors: pay-online, pay-wallet, pay-cos, cos-note.
rca of the issue: No bug found. Feature works as specified.
